description:
PropLane is property management built for landlords who rent by the room.

List a whole home or each room on its own. Every application, lease, rent charge, tour, and move-in inspection is tracked per room — so a four-bedroom house with four residents is four clean records, not one tangled spreadsheet.

RENT BY THE ROOM
• List rooms individually, each with its own price, availability, and photos
• See at a glance which rooms are open and which are occupied
• Shared rooms: set the number of beds and never double-book one

FILL EMPTY ROOMS FASTER
• Prospects book tours from the times you make available
• Applications arrive per room, with screening and background checks
• Approve an applicant and place them in their room

LEASES, SIGNED IN-APP
• Generate a lease per room from the terms you set
• Send for signature, countersign, and keep the executed copy
• Upload an existing lease and PropLane reads the terms for you

RENT, COLLECTED
• One move-in total for the resident; a full ledger for you
• Automatic reminders before rent is due
• Incoming and outgoing payments, income and expenses, per property

RESIDENTS AND MOVE-INS
• Residents photograph their own room at move-in and move-out
• Service requests routed to the vendors you already use
• One inbox for residents, applicants, and vendors — plus a PropLane assistant that answers from your real records

ONE APP, EVERY SIDE
Managers, residents, and vendors each get their own portal with the same login. Residents apply, sign, pay, and request services from their phone.

Whether you rent one spare room or run a portfolio of shared houses, PropLane keeps every room, every resident, and every dollar in its place.

PropLane Pro and PropLane Business are auto-renewing monthly subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your Apple Account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your Apple Account settings after purchase.
